feed_summary: Your team is remediating more vulnerabilities than ever, yet your breach risk has barely changed. You’re spending too much time and effort on exposures attackers may never exploit, while higher-risk exposures sit, waiting in the queue. title: The 4 Elements of Exposure Prioritization and How to Operationalize Them
